cases.title: Risk cases
cases.search: Search work code, title or district…
cases.emptyHint: Widen the filters, clear the search, or switch authority scope.
cases.selectHint: Choose a case from the list to see why it was flagged, the evidence behind it, and the actions available to your authority.
case.disclaimer: Decision-support output: every flag is a risk indicator requiring human review by the competent authority. Nothing here is a finding of fraud or wrongdoing against any individual or agency.
case.trace.intro: Each agent works independently. The orchestrator combines their findings into one score and one recommendation.
case.trace.synthText: Combines every agent signal into one composite score.
case.plan.empty: No actions available to this authority
case.ai.fallbackTail: The analysis below is complete — only the wording differs.
case.ai.permittedNote: Computed deterministically from role, risk level and the evidence found — with no model involvement. The AI may only select and sequence from this list.
case.ai.rejected: Suggested actions removed by the constraint engine because they fall outside this authority's permissions: {count}.
case.ai.unverified: Figures that could not be matched to the underlying evidence: {figures}. Treat these as unverified.
fallback.no_api_key: No AI provider key is configured, so the deterministic layer produced this.
fallback.timeout: The AI service did not respond in time.
fallback.rate_limited: The AI service rate limit was reached.
fallback.unauthorized: The AI service rejected the configured key.
fallback.language_guardrail: The AI response failed a safety check and was discarded.
fallback.language_mismatch: The AI response was not written in the chosen language, so the deterministic layer produced this.
fallback.incomplete_response: The AI response was empty, so the deterministic layer produced this.

data.title: Data source & provenance
data.sub: Where the analysed corpus comes from, and how current it is
data.batch.check: {title} — this batch holds {local} recommended works; the official portal reported {live} when queried at {date}. That is {coverage} ({tenure}).
data.llm.title: AI synthesis provider
data.llm.noKey: No {key} is set, so case synthesis uses the deterministic layer. Add a key to {env} and restart the API to enable AI synthesis. Every other capability is unaffected.
data.ledger.subLive: Where each part of the corpus comes from. Work records are read directly from the eSAKSHI portal and kept current by the poller; fund positions before 2023 come from the OpenCity open-data portal
data.ledger.subBatch: Dual-mode ingestion: live official interfaces are attempted under a strict time budget, with the official CSV exports supplying the corpus when live access is slow or partial
data.eras.noteLive: Pre-2023 rows come from the OpenCity open-data records listed in the ledger; post-2023 rows are aggregated from the eSAKSHI work records. Keeping the eras apart is what makes era-separated baselines possible.
data.eras.noteBatch: Pre-2023 rows come from the live open-data interfaces, which is what makes the era-separated baselines real rather than hypothetical.
sync.title: Live sync with the portal
ops.title: Running unattended
ops.sub: The supervisor keeps the poller, the API and this site running, backs the database up daily and raises an alert when something stays wrong.
ops.howTo: Started by hand, so nothing restarts a stopped process and no backups are taken. Run {cmd}, or {script} to start it at every sign-in.
sync.sub: The poller asks mplads.mospi.gov.in for its counts every {every} s and re-reads only the areas whose counts moved; every area is also re-read record by record {nightly}
sync.subRotation: The poller asks mplads.mospi.gov.in for its counts every {every} s and re-reads only the areas whose counts moved; {hours} it also re-reads the area read longest ago at each check, so edits that change no figure arrive within hours; every area is also re-read record by record {nightly}
sync.notRunning: {bold}, so changes on the portal are not being picked up and the figures here are as of the last check. Start it with {cmd}, or launch everything with {script}.
sync.stale_one: {count} portal check has failed repeatedly and is not updating:
sync.stale_other: {count} portal checks have failed repeatedly and are not updating:
sync.staleTail: Their last good records are kept and shown.
sync.portalDownBold: The eSAKSHI portal is not answering, so updates are paused.
sync.portalDown: Failing since {since}. The poller tries again at about {next}; until then the last good data is shown.
sync.rotationOff: areas are re-read when their counts move, and nightly
sync.areasMatching: Areas matching the portal on every figure
sync.areasMatchingHint: counts and rupees, all four portal figures
sync.quarantinedHint: held back until they pass validation
sync.keptHistory: kept in history; restored if listed again
live.tip.notRunning: The poller is not running, so portal changes are not being picked up.
live.tip.portalDown: The portal is not answering; next attempt about {time}.
live.tip.every: The eSAKSHI portal is checked every {every} s; only areas whose counts moved are re-read.
live.tip.rotation: The area read longest ago is also re-read {hours}.
live.tip.parity: {n} of {m} areas match the portal on every figure
live.tip.count: {n} of {m} areas match the portal's own count
analysis.waitPoller: newer portal changes wait for the poller
analysis.autoOff: newer portal changes wait: automatic re-runs are off
analysis.nextCheck: newer portal changes are included at the next check
analysis.includedBy: newer portal changes are included by {time}
parity.title: Portal parity
parity.sub: The portal's own dashboard figures beside ASTRA's, rebuilt from the stored records after every update and checked area by area
parity.note: Works listed only from the sanctioned report onward are stored and counted under sanctioned, completed and expenditure, exactly as the portal counts them. A work the portal stops listing is removed after a second read confirms it, and kept in history.
parity.dupNote: The portal lists {count} work(s) more than once; they are mirrored as listed.
updates.title: Latest portal updates
updates.sub: Areas re-read because their records changed on the portal, newest first. New works appear here
updates.works.title: Recently updated works
updates.works.sub: Changes to existing works, old and new value exactly as observed on the portal
updates.works.none: No edits to existing works observed yet. Newly recommended works appear under Latest portal updates.

action.request_status_update.label: Request a project status update
action.request_status_update.detail: Ask the implementing agency, through the district authority, for the current physical and financial status of this work.
action.seek_clarification.label: Seek clarification on the flagged concern
action.seek_clarification.detail: Ask the district authority for a written explanation of the specific issue identified before the next instalment is recommended.
action.monitor_progress.label: Monitor implementation progress
action.monitor_progress.detail: Track this work in the constituency review until the concern is closed.
action.raise_with_authority.label: Raise the matter with the implementing authority
action.raise_with_authority.detail: Formally record the concern with the district authority so it enters their verification queue.
action.verify_documents.label: Verify sanction and utilisation documents
action.verify_documents.detail: Check the sanction order, detailed estimate and utilisation certificate on record against what the system observed.
action.review_expenditure.label: Review expenditure records
action.review_expenditure.detail: Reconcile released and disbursed amounts against the measurement book and payment vouchers.
action.compare_with_benchmark.label: Compare the estimate against approved rates
action.compare_with_benchmark.detail: Compare the sanctioned cost with the state Schedule of Rates for this work type and quantity.
action.cross_check_duplicate.label: Cross-check the potentially repeated record
action.cross_check_duplicate.detail: Compare this work's file against the matched work to confirm whether they are separate assets at separate locations.
action.request_progress_report.label: Request a dated progress report from the agency
action.request_progress_report.detail: Obtain the current physical progress with a revised completion date and the recorded reason for delay.
action.conduct_physical_inspection.label: Conduct a physical site inspection
action.conduct_physical_inspection.detai: Verify on site that the asset exists, matches the sanctioned scope, and is at the recorded location.
action.mark_under_review.label: Mark the case under review
action.mark_under_review.detail: Record in eSAKSHI that verification is in progress so the state and Ministry views reflect it.
action.escalate_case.label: Escalate the case for higher-level review
action.escalate_case.detail: Refer the case to the State Nodal Authority with the verification findings attached.
action.request_district_review.label: Request a district-level review
action.request_district_review.detail: Ask the concerned district authority to verify this case and report back within the monitoring cycle.
action.compare_across_districts.label: Compare the pattern across districts
action.compare_across_districts.detail: Check whether the same work type, agency or anomaly recurs in other districts of the state.
action.review_agency_portfolio.label: Review this agency's wider portfolio
action.review_agency_portfolio.detail: Examine other works handled by the same implementing agency or vendor for a common cause.
action.prioritise_for_monitoring.label: Prioritise the case for monitoring
action.prioritise_for_monitoring.detail: Add the case to the state monitoring list for the next review cycle.
action.seek_district_report.label: Seek a consolidated report from district authorities
action.seek_district_report.detail: Request a written report covering this case and comparable cases in the district.
action.escalate_systemic_pattern.label: Refer the systemic pattern upward
action.escalate_systemic_pattern.detail: Where the pattern spans districts, refer it to the Ministry with the supporting comparison.
action.monitor_national_pattern.label: Monitor the national and state-level pattern
action.monitor_national_pattern.detail: Track how often this detection type occurs across states to distinguish a local issue from a systemic one.
action.review_rule_threshold.label: Review the detection threshold
action.review_rule_threshold.detail: Assess this rule's false-positive rate from reviewer feedback before changing its threshold.
action.request_state_review.label: Request a review from the State Nodal Authority
action.request_state_review.detail: Ask the concerned state to verify this case and report on comparable cases.
action.prioritise_systemic_issue.label: Prioritise the issue for scheme-level attention
action.prioritise_systemic_issue.detail: Where the same category recurs across states, place it on the scheme monitoring agenda.
action.seek_additional_information.label: Seek additional information from the relevant authorities
action.seek_additional_information.detai: Request supporting records needed to determine whether the pattern is systemic.
action.consider_guidance_update.label: Consider a scheme-level monitoring intervention
action.consider_guidance_update.detail: Where a pattern is confirmed across states, consider guidance or reporting changes for the scheme.
unchecked.3.1.2.1: Works outside the MP's usual region: the data does not map a constituency to its districts.
unchecked.3.2.5: Sanctions within the entitlement up to the year: interest, redistribution and part-year allocations (para 10.4.3) are not in the data.
unchecked.3.2.6: Model code of conduct periods: no calendar of them is held, so time limits are counted without excluding them.
unchecked.5.2.4: Naming an asset after a person: not recorded in work descriptions.
unchecked.5.4.1: SC/ST area shares: the data does not say which works are in SC/ST-inhabited areas.
unchecked.6.2.6.2: Rs 1 crore a term for any one society or trust: works do not name the society or trust they are for. The Rs 50 lakh a year limit for all of them together is checked.
unchecked.8.12.1: Calamity works: calamity consents are totals, not linked to works.
unchecked.10.6.1: Former MPs' works: the portal reports read cover members' current terms, and none of those terms has ended.
unchecked.11.4.1: Utilisation certificates: not published through the dashboard interface.
